text:
maya_enable: Quick re-engage plan for Ember alpha  enrollments at 8/20, a couple orgs marked low-engagement. Proposing a weekend push: short \"office hours + quick lab\" sequence to give fast wins.

vik_csm: Weekend push sounds good. Which accounts are we prioritizing? I can handle outreach to the mid-tier ARR ones.

maya_enable: Priority: Ember-Intl (low WAU), Ember-Insights (no feature usage), Ember-Docs (trial stuck at API key step).

toni_se: I can create a tiny Dockerized demo that runs locally (<10m) so security-conscious teams can try without cloud keys. Will add env var instructions.

amir_pm: Nice. Also propose a 2-step incentive: small usage credit + an onboarding checklist badge (public recognition in cohort leaderboard). That seemed to nudge adoption last time.

maya_enable: Love the leaderboard idea. Can we also run a 1-click RSVP CTA inside the invite linking to the repo and the poll? Short survey: 1) Did you run the lab? (y/n) 2) Are you likely to expand seats in 30d? (scale) 3) Biggest blocker (free text).

toni_se: I'll push the Docker demo and a one-file Node example to the shared drive by Sat 10am:
```
# node example
const R = require('redwood');
const c = new R.Client({apiKey: process.env.RD_KEY});
(async ()=>{ const r = await c.rerank({model:'tiny-rank', query:'invoice', documents:['Inv A','Inv B']}); console.log(r); })();
```

vik_csm: I'll draft the outreach email and a DM template for the two admins. Target send time Sat 11am PT for higher open rates.

amir_pm: I'll create the leaderboard badge assets and a tiny landing page with session times (Sat 16:00 PT and Sun 08:00 CET).

maya_enable: Action items recap: Toni - demos + README (Sat 10am). Vik - outreach + DM templates (Sat 11am). Amir - leaderboard + landing page + poll (Sat 9am). Maya - schedule invites and tag renewal-risk in CRM.

opsbot: calendar: Ember alpha weekend office hours created: Sat 16:00 PT & Sun 08:00 CET. link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/ember-weekend-5544

maya_enable: If signups are low after the first session, we'll do targeted 1:1 calls Mon morning. Thanks team.

opsbot: thread will auto-archive after 7 days of inactivity.
